title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654.4M FY26 revenue with 17.4% Y-o-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3.2% Q-o-Q and 16.2% Y-o-Y growth. Our 27,500+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix*®* Assessment 2026.

**About Position:**

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy production-grade Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions for enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience working with Python, Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, machine learning frameworks, cloud platforms, and MLOps practices. You will play a key role in building scalable AI-powered applications, developing intelligent automation capabilities, and delivering innovative solutions that drive business value.

* **Role: Senior AI/ML Engineer**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 8 to 10 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML solutions for enterprise-scale applications and platforms.
* Build production-ready AI systems leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), Machine Learning, and Generative AI technologies.
* Develop scalable data pipelines and AI workflows to support model training, inference, and continuous improvement.
* Design, train, test, evaluate, and optimize machine learning models for performance, scalability, reliability, and security.
* Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions and intelligent search capabilities.
* Develop prompt engineering strategies and optimize interactions with foundation models.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, product teams, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into AI-driven solutions.
* Integrate AI services with enterprise applications through APIs, microservices, and cloud-native architectures.
* Deploy, monitor, maintain, and enhance AI applications in production environments.
* Implement MLOps frameworks to automate model training, deployment, versioning, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
* Perform model performance analysis, validation, and continuous optimization.
* Ensure Responsible AI practices, governance, security, and compliance requirements are followed.
* Support troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and production issue resolution.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture designs, and operational runbooks.
* Stay updated with emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry best practices.

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 8-10 years of experience in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or Advanced Analytics.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Python and AI application development.
* Experience building enterprise-grade AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Machine Learning, and Generative AI technologies.
* Strong knowledge of model development, evaluation, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Hands-on experience with AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of Machine Learning algorithms, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Generative AI concepts.
* Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases.
* Expertise in building and managing data pipelines and large-scale data processing workflows.
* Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate, FAISS, or similar platforms.
* Experience integrating AI services through APIs and microservices-based architectures.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform and their AI/ML services.
* Strong understanding of MLOps practices including model deployment, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, version control, and lifecycle management.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, containerized deployments, and cloud-native architectures.
* Knowledge of observability, logging, monitoring, performance optimization, scalability, reliability, and AI security practices.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, debugging, and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

**Let’s unleash your full potential at Persistent -** **persistent.com/careers**

description:

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

We are seeking a skilled **Senior IT Analyst Applications** to join **Strategic Procurement** -**CAT IT Division.**

  

The preference for this role is to be based out of **Whitefield PSN Office -Bangalore, KA-India**

**This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office**

**What you will do**

This role is responsible for modernizing the application portfolio that supports Procurement processes.

  

**What You Will do:**

* Translate complex technical topics into clear business outcomes, options, risks, and recommendations for stakeholders.
* Promote reusable components, engineering standards, DevSecOps practices, documentation, and continuous improvement across the application portfolio.

**What You Have:**

  

* Partner with Procurement leaders, business users, product owners, architects, and delivery teams to understand business processes, pain points, and modernization priorities.
* Assess legacy applications and define pragmatic modernization approaches, including re-platforming, refactoring, integration, data migration, and retirement.
* Design and develop responsive user experiences with ReactJS and scalable services and REST APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
* Build, deploy, and support secure cloud solutions on AWS, applying appropriate architecture, integration, monitoring, and operational practices.
* Evaluate and implement generative AI use cases using Amazon Bedrock, with appropriate security, governance, and responsible AI controls.
* Design data solutions and integrations using Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Oracle, SnapLogic, APIs, and related ETL patterns.
* Lead requirements analysis, solution design, estimation, development, code reviews, testing, deployment, defect resolution, and post-go-live support.
* Translate complex technical topics into clear business outcomes, options, risks, and recommendations for stakeholders.
* Promote reusable components, engineering standards, DevSecOps practices, documentation, and continuous improvement across the application portfolio.

**Top Candidates Will Have:**

  

* Proven delivery of at least one large-scale application modernization, cloud migration, or legacy platform transformation.
* Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, or AI-enabled enterprise applications.
* Experience establishing modern front-end and back-end architecture standards and reusable engineering patterns.
* Knowledge of procurement, supplier management, master data, or related enterprise business processes.
* Experience with data migration, data quality, integration architecture, and analytics or reporting solutions.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

**Additional Information**:

* Location: Bangalore, India.
* Up to 10% travel may be required.

**Education / Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.

**Skill Descriptors**  
**Core Application Systems:** Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.  
**Level Extensive Experience:**
  

* Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
* Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
* Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.
* Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.
* Tracks data flow between own applications and core applications in other business areas.
* Plans enhancement, conversion, and retirement strategies for core applications.

  
**Problem Solving:** Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.  
**Level Extensive Experience:**
  

* Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort.
* Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
* Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
* Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
* Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
* Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

  
**Application Design, Architecture:** Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.  
**Level Extensive Experience:**
  

* Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
* Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
* Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
* Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
* Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

**Implementation:** Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).  
**Level Working Knowledge:**
  

* Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
* Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
* Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
* Provides instant support for end users of application software.
* Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

  
**Requirements Analysis:** Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.  
**Level Extensive Experience:**
  

* Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms.
* Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
* Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.
* Produces detailed functional and information requirements models and documentation.
* Trains others on requirements walkthroughs and quality reviews.
* Utilizes automated diagramming tools to ensure traceability of requirements.

  
**System and Technology Integration:** Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.  
**Level Extensive Experience:**
  

* Designs and develops applications or technology interfaces and bridges.
* Documents existing best practices for system or technology integration processes.
* Identifies and quantifies risks of proposed alternatives to a system or technology integration initiative.
* Delivers training on major issues, interfaces, considerations and potential pitfalls and risks.
* Discusses with line areas on data, technology and application integration issues.
* Advises others in how to integrate projects across multiple technologies.

  
**System Testing:** Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.  
**Level Extensive Experience:**
  

* Verifies the proper flow of transactions across all input, output and storage channels or devices.
* Evaluates interoperability of new systems with existing systems during the beta testing phase.
* Supervises the testing of complex, multi-platform and distributed applications.
* Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations.
* Coaches end users on the development of test data and test scenarios for system validation.
* Manages the execution of test plans, including resources, strategies, schedules, processes and tools.

  
**Technical Troubleshooting:** Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.  
**Level Working Knowledge:**
  

* Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems.
* Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities.
* Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards.
* Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting.
* Records and reports specific technical problems, solving processes and tools that have been used.

title: AI Expert (m/f/d)
description:
**SKIDATA** is a global leader in access solutions for mobility, parking, mountain destinations, airports, shopping centres, stadiums, and attractions, combining long-term reliability with cutting-edge innovation through the hybrid integration of hardware and software across IoT, cloud, and mobility technologies. As part of our ongoing digital transformation, we are investing boldly in AI-driven engineering and intelligent automation, and we’re now looking for a passionate, hands-on **Software Expert – Lead AI Developer** in Bangalore, India, to lead the practical adoption of AI across our software development lifecycle and help shape how we build the next generation of intelligent access systems.

  

#### **What You’ll Do**

  

* **Drive Practical AI Adoption:** Bring AI to life across the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements, architecture, and coding to code review, testing, debugging, documentation, refactoring, and maintenance.
* **Partner with Development Teams:** Work side by side with engineers and architects to uncover real day-to-day engineering challenges and co-create pilot AI-enabled solutions that make a tangible difference.
* **Lead by Example:** Use AI extensively in your own daily engineering work and demonstrate measurable improvements in productivity and quality.
* **Mentor and Inspire:** Act as an AI technical leader and mentor for software engineering teams across locations, through hands-on workshops, coaching sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities.
* **Turn Experiments into Standards:** Establish practical guidelines and repeatable workflows for responsible AI-assisted development, and integrate them into existing processes together with architects, technical managers, and engineering leaders.
* **Explore What’s Next:** Evaluate emerging AI development tools, models, frameworks, and agentic approaches, including locally hosted and open-source LLMs, with a clear view of their cost, performance, and operational trade-offs.
* **Champion an AI-First Mindset:** Help teams embrace AI-first engineering while safeguarding quality, security, and maintainability, and bring relevant external developments into the organization where they create real value.

  

In this role, you’ll become the go-to technical point of contact for AI-assisted software development and play a key part in building a sustainable, AI-enabled engineering culture. Within your first 6–12 months, you’ll see the impact of your work in stronger internal AI capabilities, high-value use cases brought to life, and measurable gains in developer productivity, software quality, and delivery efficiency. Here, your ideas are valued, your curiosity is encouraged, and you’ll have the exciting opportunity to shape the way our engineers work for years to come.

  

#### **What You Bring**

  

* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with AI/Generative AI technologies, or equivalent recent, demonstrable experience applying AI extensively in real-world software engineering
* Strong hands-on expertise in modern software development, architecture, design patterns, APIs, cloud-based systems, testing, and engineering practices
* Practical experience with AI-powered development tools such as Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent
* Real projects where AI measurably improved development speed, quality, automation, or engineering outcomes
* Proven ability to mentor senior and junior engineers and influence teams without formal authority
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and technical communication skills
* A pragmatic, hands-on mindset that balances innovation with quality, security, maintainability, and business value
* Strong curiosity, a passion for experimentation, and a drive to keep learning emerging AI technologies
* Experience with LLM ecosystems (e.g., Anthropic/Claude, OpenAI), prompt and context engineering, AI agent workflows, LLM integration, locally hosted or open-source LLMs, AI coding standards and governance, or leading AI transformation within an engineering organization is a plus

  

#### **What You Can Expect**

  

* **Health Insurance** – Group Mediclaim (₹5L floater) covering employee, spouse & children; plus Group Personal Accident & Term Life Insurance (2x annual CTC each)
* **Wellness** – Annual health check-up + ₹5,000/year reimbursement for gym, yoga & wellness memberships
* **Leave** – 30 working days/year + 13 national holidays; Maternity (26 weeks), Paternity (5 days), Miscarriage & Marriage leave
* **Flexible Work** – Hybrid model with up to 8 WFH days/month
* **Gift Vouchers** – For birthdays, weddings & newborns
* **Meals & Snacks** – ₹1,500/month via Pluxee Cards
* **Daycare Support** – Creche/daycare reimbursement for women employees (up to 2 children)
* **Financial Benefits** – NPS contributions, Gratuity, short-term loans via HDFC Bank
* **Rewards** – Spot & Bravo awards, Service Completion Awards (3/5/10 years)
* **Referral Bonus** – ₹35,000 per successful referral
* **Engagement** – Ongoing team events, activities & learning programs

  

**Location:** Bangalore, India | Full-time

  

**Ready to make an impact? Apply today and be a part of SKIDATA’s innovative journey!**

  

**Your Personal Contact**

Chandan V – Recruiter – chandan.v@skidata.com

Innovative solutions at the cutting edge, a dynamic and forward-thinking work environment, and diverse opportunities – welcome to the world of SKIDATA. Join our strong, international team now and help shape the future of modern access solutions with your creativity and expertise. title: Quality Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**

The Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring the delivery of high‑quality software through a combination of manual and automated testing practices. This role works closely with Development, Product, DevOps, and Delivery teams to validate functionality, improve test coverage, identify defects early, and continuously enhance the quality of products and platforms. The QE contributes to test strategy, builds automation frameworks, and helps foster a culture of quality throughout the engineering organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Test Planning & Strategy**

* Collaborate with Product Owners and Developers to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, and system behaviour.
* Participate in story refinement to ensure testability and clear acceptance criteria.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans, test cases, and regression suites.
* Contribute to the overall QA strategy, including test coverage goals, automation priorities, and risk-based testing.

**Functional & Non‑Functional Testing**

* Implement functional, regression, integration, system, and exploratory testing.
* Validate API responses, UI behaviour, workflows, and data integrity across environments.
* Perform non‑functional testing such as performance, usability, or basic security validation as needed.
* Ensure defects are clearly documented, reproducible, and communicated effectively.

**Test Automation Development**

* Design, build, and maintain automated test suites using modern automation frameworks.
* Create and execute automated regression tests for UI, API, and service layers.
* Partner with Developers and DevOps to integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
* Ensure automation provides meaningful value by reducing manual effort and enabling early defect detection.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Work closely with Developers to understand architecture, code changes, and risk areas.
* Collaborate with DevOps to ensure environments, data, and pipelines support effective testing.
* Participate in sprint ceremonies, defect triage, and release readiness activities.
* Drive improvements in test processes, tooling, automation, and engineering practices.
* Advocate for quality throughout the SDLC and promote shift‑left testing.

**Release & Production Support**

* Validate builds and deployments in test environments; provide go/no‑go input for releases.
* Assist in root cause analysis for production issues and contribute to long‑term fixes.
* Monitor product quality trends and highlight risk areas or repeat issues.

**Skills & Qualifications**

**Required**

* 3+ years of experience in software testing or quality engineering.
* Solid understanding of QA methodologies, SDLC, and Agile (Scrum/Kanban).
* Experience creating functional and regression test cases; strong attention to detail.
* Familiarity with test automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Postman, Rest Assured).
* Experience testing APIs, web applications, or distributed systems.
* Ability to work collaboratively with multi-functional teams.

* Experience building automation frameworks (UI, API, or service-level).

description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

As a Senior AI Engineer , you will combine deep classical analytics craft, data engineering, with modern AI-native ways of working. You will design and deliver AI frameworks which can be scaled across the enterprise, and leverage LLMs, agents, and RAG to unlock measurable business KPIs. You will partner closely with FLIGHT DECK, publish AI workflows and agents, and help raise the AI capability of the analytics community around you as an emerging AI Coach.

**Job Description**
===================

**Company Overview**

Working at GE Aerospace means you are bringing your unique perspective, innovative spirit, drive, and curiosity to a collaborative and diverse team working to advance aerospace for future generations. If you have ideas, we will listen. Join us and see your ideas take flight!

**Site Overview**

Established in 2000, the John F. Welch Technology Center (JFWTC) in Bengaluru is our multidisciplinary research and engineering center. Engineers and scientists at JFWTC have contributed to hundreds of aviation patents, pioneering breakthroughs in engine technologies, advanced materials, and additive manufacturing.

**Role Overview:**

  

* Find, interpret, and merge data sources, ensure dataset consistency, create visualisations, and communicate insights simply — using AI-augmented tooling (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, LLM analytics assistants) to accelerate exploration and narrative generation.
* Prioritise, prototype, design, build, test, and deploy analytics models and AI agents in an agile methodology — including RAG on enterprise data, natural-language querying, and LLM-driven data quality and anomaly detection.
* Develop analytic/AI solutions from various source systems— augmented with AI-assisted profiling, entity resolution, and quality-check pipelines.
* Develop technical expertise in AI development for engineering applications— including next-generation 'ask-the-data' experiences powered by LLMs on top of the enterprise Data Fabric.
* Present project plans, technical roadmaps, risks, and recommendations to senior leaders — including AI/analytics adoption roadmaps tied to measurable business KPIs.
* Work closely with the Engineering teams and AI leadership to identify AI-enabled analytics use-cases (agents, copilots, conversational dashboards); translate AI-driven insights into business language for non-technical stakeholders.
* Serve as a technical specialist in the discipline — deep expertise in classical analytics and applied AI/ML for enterprise data.
* Partner closely with FLIGHT DECK and business-defined priorities to build, scale, and industrialise AI-powered analytics workflows, agents, and connectors — end-to-end to production adoption.
* Define and enforce enterprise-grade AI standards, guardrails, and best practices — responsible AI, evaluation, security, observability — so AI-powered insights are trustworthy and production-grade.
* Coach and enable AI Builders across the analytics community: teach AI Foundations, review agents/workflows, unblock architectural barriers, and align team practices with Data Fabric standards.
* Develop communication, training, and change-management deliverables to increase adoption of analytics and AI capabilities; establish a community of practice around AI-augmented analytics.

**Ideal Candidate:**

  

* Ideal candidate should have experience in SQL/Python fundamentals plus fluency in AI-augmented development — using AI as a productivity multiplier without compromising data correctness, lineage, or governance.

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's in Engineering/Technology/Aerospace or "STEM" Majors with a minimum of 8 years of experience.
* Strong oral and written communication skills; strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
* Demonstrated ability to lead programs and projects — document, plan, market, and execute end-to-end; established project-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse and resolve problems — including framing ambiguous business questions as AI/analytics problems and back.
* Strong SQL/Python fundamentals plus fluency in AI-augmented development — using AI as a productivity multiplier without compromising data correctness, lineage, or governance.
* Hands-on with modern AI development tooling: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, LLM orchestration frameworks, agent frameworks, vector databases, and RAG patterns applied to enterprise data.
* Deep experience building secure and scalable enterprise AI-analytics solutions — deploying connectors, agents, and artifacts that enable others to scale AI adoption.
* Cloud proficiency (AWS, GCP, Azure) with data-engineering fundamentals and cybersecurity awareness.
* Coaching mindset (aligned with the AI Coach persona) — comfortable teaching AI Foundations and lifting the AI capability of analysts and engineers around you; can support ~6–8 AI Builders.
* Continuous learner who keeps pace with external AI/analytics capabilities and brings insights back to shape enterprise standards and Data Fabric alignment.
* Formal AI/ML certifications a plus — AWS Certified ML, GCP Professional ML Engineer, Azure AI Engineer, Databricks ML.

At GE Aerospace, we have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. Here, you will have the opportunity to work on really cool things with really smart and collaborative people. Together, we will mobilize a new era of growth in aerospace and defense. Where others stop, we accelerate.

description:
**GLOBAL BANKING & MARKETS**

We make markets in and clear client transactions on major stock, options and futures exchanges worldwide. Through our global sales force, we maintain relationships with our clients, receiving orders and distributing investment research, trading ideas, market information and analysis.

  

**OPERATIONS**

Transaction Banking Operations is a part of Transaction Banking within the Investment Banking Division. We are responsible for building, developing and supporting Goldman Sachs’ Transaction Banking offering which is delivering a range of treasury and cash management products to our corporate client base. Transaction Banking Operations provide essential risk management and controls architecture to preserve and enhance the firm’s assets and reputation. For every new product launched and every trade executed, it is Operations that develop and manage the processes and controls that enable business flow.

  

**OUR IMPACT**

Transaction Banking Operations is focused on scaling the Transaction Banking businesses and supporting the constantly evolving suite of innovative Transaction Banking Services we offer clients, while adapting to the rapidly changing payment landscape.

  

Our organization is the first line of defense for control and governance to protect both clients’ and the firm’s financial assets, while delivering a differentiated, best-in-class client service. Transaction Banking Operations is a growing team with regional presence in Singapore, Bengaluru, London, New York, and Dallas. All our offices work closely together as a single global team in support of our Transaction Banking business.

  

The team plays a critical role in understanding the end-to-end client journey, identifying which Operations teams will be impacted by roadmap deliverables, and coordinating readiness activities so that the functional operations teams are prepared to support clients effectively.

  

In addition to business-as-usual operational readiness, the team supports key enablement programs Transaction Banking Operations.

  

**YOUR IMPACT**

We are seeking to recruit an individual to join our Operations Enablement team in TxB Operations. The Operations Enablement team provides various central services to help drive the growth and scalability of operations to meet the business needs of TxB and its clients.

  

The ideal candidate will be integral to ensure that new products, features and enhancements are operational ready before they go live. He/she will be organized, collaborative, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing work across multiple stakeholders while helping translate product and client journey changes into practical operational actions.

  

**HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL**

* Support operational readiness for Transaction Banking product roadmap deliverables, ensuring impacted Operations teams are prepared to support new products, features, enhancements, and client-facing capabilities before go-live.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Risk, Legal, Compliance, and functional Operations teams to understand roadmap deliverables’ scope, assess operational impacts, track dependencies, and drive readiness activities to completion.
* Develop a strong understanding of the end-to-end Transaction Banking client journey and use that perspective to identify which teams, processes, controls, procedures, and client support models may be impacted by upcoming changes.

* Support user acceptance testing by helping define operational test scenarios, coordinating participation from functional Operations teams, tracking defects or feedback, and ensuring operational considerations are addressed prior to production release.
* Maintain clear project documentation, action logs, status updates, decision records, and readiness materials using tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, and QuickSight.
* Contribute to Operations Enablement programs that help improve operational transparency, client experience, and execution discipline across Transaction Banking Operations.
* Identify, evaluate and support ways to leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML) to streamline manual workflows and eliminate operations bottlenecks across TxB Operations teams.
  

**SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

  

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree with at least 3 years of relevant professional experience in Operations, project management, business analysis, product implementation, client service, or related financial services function
* Good understanding of transaction banking, correspondence banking, cash management, treasury management, Liquidity and Payments products, especially from an Operations perspective.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage milestones, dependencies, risks, action items, and follow-ups across multiple workstreams
* Ability to partner effectively with cross-functional stakeholders, communicate clearly, and drive alignment on operational readiness needs and timelines
* Ability to understand business requirements, product changes, and client journey impacts, and translate them into practical readiness actions for impacted Operations teams
* Experience supporting change initiatives, product or feature launches, operational implementation activities, or other cross-functional delivery efforts
* Experience participating in user acceptance testing, including documenting test scenarios, coordinating participants, tracking issues, and supporting readiness decisions prior to launch
* Ability to work in a cross-functional team set up and operate at an agile and nimble pace to manage business and project outcomes.
* Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to identify risks, gaps, dependencies, and practical solutions
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, with the ability to synthesize information into clear updates, trackers, presentations, and decision materials

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in Transaction Banking, cash management, payments, client onboarding, client implementation, client service, or Operations support functions
* Familiarity with the Software Development Life Cycle, Agile delivery practices, product roadmaps, release management, or production go-live governance
* Experience using JIRA and Confluence to track work, manage documentation, coordinate issue resolution, or support cross-functional delivery
* Experience with Power BI, AWS Quick, or similar reporting and data visualization tools to interpret data and generate reports (hands-on dashboard development)
* Experience with process mapping, procedure documentation, control documentation, or operational workflow analysis
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments, connecting related workstreams, asking thoughtful questions, and helping stakeholders reach clarity.

title: Support Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**

Our customers are at the forefront of some of the most interesting data in the world, using SingleStore to push the boundaries every day. To do this well, they leverage the expertise of our Support Engineering Team, composed of technical subject matter experts on the frontline of critical customer issues.

This Support Engineering role skews far more towards engineering than typical technical support as you will need to delve into database internals and memory allocators, investigate Linux and host-related configurations, and diagnose SQL query behaviour, all in the name of resolving complex database issues. Our Support Engineers are constantly learning a wide range of customer systems and technical concepts and are thrilled by the new and exciting challenges that they encounter on a regular basis.

To accurately identify the source and solution of an issue, this team will take the time to learn about the customer's business and systems while helping to improve their fundamental SingleStore and database operational knowledge. This often requires additional research and time spent on learning new technologies and tools outside of SingleStore while also being deeply engaged with multiple departments including development teams, query performance engineering, product management, infrastructure SREs, etc.

**Required Hours**

* The hours required are from 11:30 AM IST - 8:30 PM IST (9 hours) for 5 days
* Participate in our on-call rotation that may include weekends and holidays.

**Role and Responsibilities**

* Provide email and live technical support to our enterprise customers, acting as the first line of defense for complex technical issues, bug diagnosis, or resolving critical outages.
* Identify and reproduce product issues, perform QA, and submit formal bug reports or feature requests to the appropriate Engineering team.
* Collaborate closely with software developers, sales engineers, and technical account managers to keep all teams up to date with current issues a customer may be facing.
* Work to streamline and improve various Support and Engineering processes and tools, author new internal run-books or public documentation, and help the team continually improve efficiency and effectiveness.
* Ensure customers have a positive support experience during every interaction.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 4+ years of advanced customer-facing technical support experience.
* Experience with MySQL or MySQL-like (MariaDB, Aurora, etc) database and SQL Query Optimization.
* A solid Kubernetes and sysadmin skill set. Also, comfortable testing software and finding its limits, hands-on with Linux, checking utilization of system I/O, measuring network throughput, and are comfortable navigating large log files.
* Experience with a scripting or coding language. Whether it's Python, Bash, or Go, you should have a go-to solution for quick and dirty problem-solving and be able to navigate through our code base.
* Familiarity with distributed systems and AWS/GCP. You understand how organizations deploy and maintain distributed applications and services across multiple machines Bonus points for knowing how to analyze them for performance bottlenecks and remove single points of failure.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Have the ability to explain technical concepts to a wide range of end-users.

Consistent with our commitment to diversity & inclusion, we value individuals with the ability to work on diverse teams and with a diverse range of people.

Job Description :

We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Architect to design, plan, and drive automation strategies across hybrid infrastructure environments. The ideal candidate holds architect-level depth in at least one public cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), combines deep classical infrastructure expertise (compute, storage, network, database) with strong DevOps, identity, and endpoint management skills, and brings hands-on strength in Terraform/Terragrunt-driven automation. They will be responsible for architecting scalable, repeatable, and secure automation frameworks across the enterprise IT landscape.

Key Responsibilities

* Design end-to-end automation architecture spanning provisioning, configuration management, patching, monitoring, and lifecycle operations across on-prem and cloud infrastructure.

* Lead automation strategy and roadmap using Azure DevOps (pipelines, repos, boards, artifacts) as the primary CI/CD and orchestration backbone.

* Architect and standardize automation for classical infrastructure domains:

* Design and govern Azure Identity & Access Management (IAM): role-based access control (RBAC), Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), automated access provisioning/deprovisioning, and identity governance across hybrid environments.

* Architect and manage SCCM (Microsoft Configuration Manager) environments for OS deployment, patch management, software distribution, and endpoint compliance automation.

* Hold architect-level ownership of at least one public cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) — landing zone design, account/subscription structure, networking, security baselines — and integrate multi-cloud DevOps practices into a unified automation framework.

* Define and enforce Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) standards with strong hands-on depth in Terraform and Terragrunt (module design, remote state management, workspace/environment isolation, DRY variable hierarchies) alongside ARM/Bicep and Ansible; own IaC governance across teams.

* Partner with delivery, operations, and security teams to translate manual/legacy processes into automated, auditable workflows.

* Own architecture documentation, automation design specs, and implementation planning (phased rollout, risk assessment, rollback strategy).

* Mentor engineering teams on automation best practices and drive adoption across the infra org.

Required Skills & Experience

* 8+ years in infrastructure engineering/architecture roles, with 3+ years focused on automation/DevOps.

* Hands-on expertise with Azure DevOps (pipelines, YAML, release management).

* Strong background across classic infrastructure: Windows Server, Linux/Unix, VMware virtualization, enterprise databases (SQL/Oracle or similar), storage & backup platforms (NetApp, Veeam, Commvault, etc.), and enterprise networking.

* Strong hands-on experience with Azure IAM — RBAC, Conditional Access, PIM, Entra ID (Azure AD) automation and governance.

* Proven experience with SCCM for endpoint management, patching, and OS/application deployment automation.

* Experience with monitoring/observability tools (SCOM, Nagios, Zabbix, Datadog, or similar) and integrating automated remediation.

* Architect-level expertise in Azure, AWS, or GCP — able to design landing zones, account/subscription hierarchies, network topology, and security/governance baselines, not just automate within an existing environment.

* Working knowledge of at least one additional public cloud beyond the primary and cloud-native DevOps tooling.

* Proficiency in scripting/automation languages: PowerShell, Python, Bash.

* Strong, hands-on IaC experience with Terraform and Terragrunt (module authoring, remote state, environment/workspace isolation, DRY configuration patterns) as the core automation toolchain, plus ARM/Bicep templates and Ansible/Chef/Puppet.

* Proven ability to produce automation design documents and implementation/rollout plans for enterprise environments.

* Excellent stakeholder communication skills — able to present automation strategy to both technical teams and leadership.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

* Certifications: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) or AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Professional) or Google Professional Cloud Architect; HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate; Azure Identity & Access Administrator (SC-300); VMware VCP; ITIL Foundation.

* Experience in regulated or large enterprise environments (banking, healthcare, government).

* Exposure to ITSM platforms (ServiceNow, BMC Helix) and CMDB-driven automation.

title: Principal AI Scientist
description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. **Job Description:**

Job Description

**Principal AI Scientist – Modern AI Applications**

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

As a **Principal AI Scientist** with deep expertise in **Agentic AI** , **Generative AI** , and **Natural Language Understanding (NLU),** you will lead high-impact technical innovation in HIS applications. In this role, you will be a **hands-on research and development leader** - driving technical breakthroughs, designing novel AI architectures, and directly influencing the integration of advanced AI into mission-critical healthcare products. You will collaborate closely with other scientists, engineers, and domain experts to create solutions that are explainable, reliable, and transformative for healthcare operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Research & Innovation**

* Design, prototype, and evaluate novel AI models for autonomous, agent-based systems in healthcare workflows.
* Advance state-of-the-art NLU for clinical, operational, and administrative healthcare text.
* Explore and implement new capabilities in reasoning, decision-making, and multi-modal understanding.

**Healthcare-Focused AI Development**

* Adapt and fine-tune large language models to handle healthcare-specific language, regulatory requirements, and ethical considerations.
* Create AI pipelines that can process structured and unstructured healthcare data (FHIR, HL7, clinical notes, claims data).
* Contribute to domain-specific model architectures that improve clinical decision-making, revenue cycle management, and patient engagement.

**Technical Leadership & Strategy**

* **Technical Authority:** Serve as the lead architect for AI/ML strategy, ensuring all models are explainable, robust, and compliant with healthcare regulations (HIPAA/HITRUST).
* **Research to Reality:** Bridge the gap between theoretical research and practical engineering, ensuring prototypes are built with deployment and maintenance in mind.
* **Mentorship:** Elevate the engineering team through rigorous code reviews, architectural design docs, and best practices in data science.

**Data & Operational Excellence**

* **Data Integrity:** Oversee the processing of structured and unstructured healthcare data (FHIR, HL7, clinical notes) ensuring high data quality and security.
* **Validation:** Implement rigorous model evaluation frameworks to detect bias and ensure clinical accuracy.

**End-to-End System Architecture**

* **Design & Deploy:** Lead the full lifecycle of AI applications, from initial data exploration and model training to deploying secure, scalable services in a production environment.
* **Hybrid Modeling:** Intelligently combine Classical ML (Random Forests, XGBoost, etc.) with Deep Learning and Generative AI to solve complex healthcare problems efficiently.
* **Agentic Frameworks:** Architect agent-based reasoning systems to automate clinical workflows while maintaining strict "human-in-the-loop" safety standards.

**Operational & Compliance Excellence**

* Implement rigorous model evaluation frameworks for accuracy, robustness, and fairness.
* Ensure compliance with healthcare privacy and data security regulations (HIPAA, HITRUST).
* Partner with engineering to move research prototypes into production environments.

**Required Qualifications**

* PhD or Master’s in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in AI/ML, with a strong portfolio of deployed models.
* Proficiency in Python, R, and modern ML libraries.
* Experience with GenAI, LLMs, and transformer architectures.
* Skilled with AI development tools and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, RAG systems).
* Hands-on experience with autonomous AI agents and reasoning systems.
* Strong track record applying AI to healthcare or life sciences use cases.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS) and MLOps practices.

**Preferred Skills**

* Multi-modal AI research experience (text, image, structured data).
* Knowledge graph integration and symbolic reasoning expertise.
* Proven ability to take AI research from concept to production.

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
**Role Overview:**

The Data Architect will be responsible for defining, designing, and governing the data architecture for Billing end to end process, that enables scalable, secure, and business-aligned data platforms! This role requires deep expertise in data modeling, cloud data warehousing, integration patterns, governance frameworks, and modern analytics architectures to support reporting, regulatory compliance, and advanced analytics.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Enterprise Data Architecture**

Define and maintain the data architecture roadmap aligned with business and technology strategies.

Design scalable and reusable data architectures, including operational, analytical, and reporting data layers.

Establish enterprise data models, conceptual, logical, and physical data models, ensuring consistency across domains.

Develop and maintain dimensional models, star schemas, and canonical data models to support reporting and analytics requirements.

Drive architecture standards, design patterns, and best practices for data platforms and integrations.

  

**Data Acquisition & Integration**

Design and govern data ingestion, integration, and transformation frameworks using native AWS tools like Glue, Air Flow and Snowflake , Data Bricks as Data Store

Architect data pipelines and integration patterns for structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data sources.

Ensure end-to-end data lineage, reconciliation, and traceability across all billing process data flows.

Define standards for data quality, validation, and data synchronization across platforms.

Optimize data movement and transformation processes for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.

  

**Cloud Data Platform & Warehousing**

Architect enterprise data solutions leveraging Snowflake and cloud platforms including AWS.

Define data storage, compute, security, and data lifecycle management strategies.

Design modern data warehouse, data lake, and lakehouse architectures to support enterprise-wide reporting and analytics.

Establish standards for data partitioning, clustering, performance optimization, and workload management.

Collaborate with infrastructure and engineering teams to ensure resilient and scalable data environments.

  

**Reporting & Analytics Enablement**

Partner with reporting and analytics teams to ensure data architectures support business intelligence and self-service analytics.

Define and maintain certified data products and semantic layers for reporting tools such as Power BI.

Ensure data models are optimized for analytical consumption and regulatory reporting requirements.

Enable consistent metrics, KPIs, and master data definitions across business functions.

  

**Governance, Metadata & Security**

Lead implementation of enterprise data governance frameworks, standards, and policies.

Establish and manage metadata management, business glossaries, and data catalog capabilities.

Define data security architecture, including role-based access controls, encryption, masking, and regulatory compliance requirements.

Ensure adherence to audit, risk, privacy, and regulatory standards.

Promote data stewardship and ownership across business and technology teams.

  

**Data Operations & Orchestration**

Define standards for workflow orchestration and scheduling using Control-M or equivalent enterprise scheduling tools.

Design monitoring frameworks for data quality, pipeline reliability, and operational excellence.

Ensure high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity considerations are embedded into data architecture designs.

  

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* Extensive experience in Data Architecture, Data Warehousing, and Enterprise Data Modeling.

* Strong expertise in Snowflake architecture, administration, and performance optimization.

* Experience with ETL/ELT platforms such as AWS Glue, Airflow, Ab Initio, Matillion, DataStage, or comparable technologies.

* Deep understanding of dimensional modeling, star schema, data vault, and enterprise data modeling techniques.

* Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure data services.

* Strong knowledge of data governance, metadata management, data lineage, and data quality frameworks.

* Experience defining architecture standards, integration patterns, and technology roadmaps.

* Understanding of security, compliance, and risk management principles for enterprise data environments.

* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and documentation skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience within Financial Services, Risk Management, Regulatory Reporting, or Compliance domains.

* Familiarity with enterprise data governance and cataloging platforms such as Collibra, Alation, or Microsoft Purview.

* Experience implementing modern data architectures including Data Lake, Lakehouse, and Data Mesh concepts.

* Knowledge of AI/ML data platform requirements and analytics ecosystems.

* Professional certifications in Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or Enterprise Architecture frameworks.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.

**The job**

The Value Realization Validation technical staff will ensure that AVEVA's value realization propositions are rigorously tested and daily monitored with automation for its customer value. A Value Realization focuses the outcome to deliver meaningful customer value, facilitates incremental value delivery to the market and respects budget guardrails and required AVEVA business benefits.

This role involves comprehensive system validation to user needs and business requirements end-to-end, and automation, ensuring that each value realizations meet customer expectations and organizational standards. The role must possess good understanding of the product/portfolio or system they are validating, as well as the tools, techniques, and technologies used in the validation process to validate against the expected outcomes. The technical staff will work closely with specialist and cross-functional teams to validate the effectiveness of the value realizations across all stages.

**Key responsibilities**

  

* Define and validate persona-based scenarios and end-to-end workflows, ensuring value realization aligns with customer needs.
* Enable and validate data flows across industrial systems, cloud platforms, and microservices architectures against functional and non-functional requirements.
* Design and execute comprehensive testing strategies (manual and automated) to ensure system reliability, scalability, performance, and data integrity.
* Collaborate with SMEs and cross-functional teams to align on data requirements, integration points, and solution architecture.
* Develop automation, performance testing, and validation frameworks while maintaining documentation and leveraging enterprise data (MES, SCADA, ERP, IoT, etc.) to generate insights and validate outcomes

**Essential requirements**

**Desired skills and competencies**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering/Computer Science/IT with 8+ years of experience in platform testing, software development, system integration, and cloud/microservices environments.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), performance testing, and system optimization techniques.
* Knowledge of microservices, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), industrial protocols (OPC, MQTT, REST), and industrial data systems (MES, SCADA, ERP, IoT, engineering tools)
* Aligned with AVEVA values of Impact, Aspiration, Curiosity, and Trust*.*

**R&D at AVEVA**

Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.

Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.

You’ll also be joining an award-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/

**India Benefits include:**

Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support

It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

**Hybrid working**

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.

So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.

**Job description**
-------------------

This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.

Join us as a Machine Learning Engineer

  
  

* In this role, you'll drive the design, development and operationalisation of machine learning and AI solutions, enabling the delivery of resilient, scalable and innovative solutions using both Generative AI and traditional Machine Learning techniques
* Day-to-day, act as a technical expert, building and deploying production-grade ML and AI systems while championing engineering best practices across the team

**What you’ll do**
------------------

  
  

We're looking for someone who can work with our Data Scientists to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable machine learning and AI solutions. You'll work closely with data scientists, engineers, architects and business stakeholders to deliver reliable and secure products that support our business strategy and customer outcomes.

  
  

You'll stay curious about emerging technologies and industry developments, helping to identify opportunities to improve our machine learning and AI platforms, tooling and delivery capabilities.

You'll also need strong software engineering experience, including cloud-native development, data engineering and machine learning operations. title: Staff IAM Engineer
description:
### **About Us**

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

### **Reports To**

Senior Manager - AI & IT

### **What You Will Be Doing**

ChargePoint is looking for a IAM Engineer to lead enterprise identity strategy and platform architecture across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. This role owns cloud identity, directory services, Okta identity workflows, and the transition of applications to modern authentication standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML). You will define and implement reference architectures for secure authentication across CLI, browser, and agentic workflows.  
You will establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows. You will build and implement Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), risk-based authentication, and Okta Identity Governance (OIG) programs. You will also scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations while maintaining reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.  
This is a hands-on technical role. You will code, design, and implement IAM solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. You will partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.  
  
**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* Lead enterprise identity strategy and platform architecture, encompassing cloud identity, directory services, and the transition of applications to modern authentication standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML).
* Define and implement reference architectures for secure authentication across CLI, browser, and agentic workflows.
* Establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows.
* Build and implement advanced identity security controls such as Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and risk-based authentication.
* Scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations. Ensure reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.
* Partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.
* Drive IAM application development: code, design, and implement solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. Deliver reliable solutions that keep engineering teams productive.
* Drive IAM projects end-to-end: take ambiguous access problems, define requirements, architect solutions, and own the rollout and operationalization — not just the design.
* Refine role design and access patterns across AWS, Kubernetes, SaaS, and internal systems — eliminate unnecessary privileges, reduce manual grants, and establish scalable baseline access.
* Run and improve user access reviews (UAR): develop, execute, and design a UAR process and solution that meets compliance requirements while improving real security signal — minimize approver burden through scoping, automation, and clear decision support.
* Identify high-risk permissions and misuse paths, build controls and mitigations, and drive adoption with partner teams to reduce risk exposure.
* Operate with strong security judgment and high signal: distinguish meaningful IAM risk from noise, gather context efficiently, and escalate with crisp rationale and actionable mitigations.
* Document and standardize the paved road: write procedures, runbooks, and automation so access decisions are consistent, scalable, and not dependent on tribal knowledge.
* Conduct Agentic AI IAM requirement analyses, architecture reviews, and security gap assessments across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, AI services, and infrastructure environments.
* Develop automation for access management and secrets lifecycle operations.
* Develop and implement security controls for AI agents, machine identities, APIs, workloads, and autonomous workflows.
* Lead enterprise Agentic AI IAM program execution across multiple workstreams.
* Establish security controls for AI agents, autonomous workflows, bots, and machine identities.
* Standardize identity governance across multi-cloud ecosystems.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 8-12 years of experience in IAM, cloud security, or cybersecurity engineering.
* Strong experience in Agentic AI IAM architecture, identity governance, secrets management, security engineering, and enterprise IAM program delivery.
* Strong expertise in requirement gathering, current-state assessments, gap analyses, control evaluations, and target-state Agentic AI IAM security architecture design.
* Experience securing cloud-native and hybrid environments and managing hybrid cloud IAM and secrets management programs.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and machine identity security.
* Experience implementing AI/Agentic security controls and secure automation frameworks.
* Platform experience: Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Google Cloud Secrets Manager, AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, container security platforms.
* Experience with Terraform, CI/CD, and DevSecOps tooling.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CCSP. (good to have)

**Location**  
  
Gurgaon/Bangalore, India

Role

Enterprise Solutions AI Applied Engineer

Why UKG:

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  
  
Core Mission
  
  
The Enterprise Applied AI Solution Specialist is a hands-on engineer who builds and deploys practical AI solutions that improve internal workflows and employee productivity. The role focuses on implementing agentic and Generative AI features using established patterns, grounded in enterprise knowledge and data.
  
  
This individual partners closely with business stakeholders to translate requirements into usable, reliable capabilities while operating within enterprise constraints such as security, governance, and user trust. The position is ideal for a builder who ships, iterates quickly, and continuously improves solution quality through feedback and measurement.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
This is a delivery-focused role combining hands-on implementation with light product ownership and operational discipline.
  
  
1. Applied Solution Delivery & Iteration (65% of time)
  
Build and enhance AI-powered features (e.g., copilots, summarization, classification, routing, Q&A) aligned to defined business workflows.
  
Partner with business users to clarify requirements, run demos, capture feedback, and iterate toward measurable outcomes.
  
Support pilot launches, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to smooth adoption through user training and clear documentation.
  
  
2. Knowledge-Based Agents & Conversational Design (25% of time)
  
Develop agents grounded in the company’s internal knowledge base, using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns and retrieval quality improvements.
  
Design conversational flows for internal functions (e.g., HR helpdesk), including intent handling, escalation paths, and handoff to human support when needed.
  
Implement simple agentic or predictive models for operational use cases (e.g., predicting customer support ticket volume) under guidance from senior engineers.
  
  
3. Product Execution, Quality & Documentation (10% of time)
  
Manage the feature backlog for an AI product area: write user stories, define acceptance criteria, and coordinate UAT.
  
Contribute to evaluation and regression testing using approved checklists; help monitor quality, latency, and cost for deployed features.
  
Create and maintain documentation (how-to guides, runbooks, and user enablement materials) to support long-term sustainability.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
3+ years of experience in software engineering or applied solutions development (or equivalent practical experience).
  
Proficiency in Python and API-based integration; working knowledge of SQL and data access patterns.
  
Working familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  
Exposure to agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar) and the ability to implement tool/function calling patterns.
  
Basic understanding of enterprise security, privacy, and data governance requirements; ability to follow established guardrails and escalate risks early.
  
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  
Ideal Candidate Profile: Who Thrives in This Role
  
Builders Over Theorists: You enjoy shipping working software and iterating based on user feedback.
  
User-Centered Mindset: You like sitting with users, mapping workflows, and improving day-to-day productivity.
  
Pragmatic Technologist: You choose simple, reliable approaches and adopt new techniques when they clearly improve outcomes.
  
Quality-Driven: You care about correctness, safety, and operational reliability, and you follow established production standards.
  
Continuous Learner: You stay current on rapidly evolving GenAI capabilities and apply them responsibly.
  
Generous Collaborator: You document clearly, communicate proactively, and work well across teams.

UKG is the Workforce Operating Platform that puts workforce understanding to work. **Kafka Senior Engineer**

  

**Who we are looking for**

As a Senior Middleware Platform Engineer, you will be working in a fast paced environment in a team of highly skilled engineers responsible for leading platform engineering, design, and implementation of next generation messaging infrastructure. You will also be expected to assist and act as final level of support for the production services supported by the team.

What you will be responsible for

  
  

**As Kafka Senior Engineer you will:**

* Design, Engineer, and Evangelize Kafka Messaging across the enterprise

* Lead in the design and engineering of our first Kafka Cluster on a Public Cloud (Azure, AWS, other) using Ansible, Terraform, Python

* Lead and assist in providing direction for Junior Engineers

* Work with Enterprise Architecture team in identifying and implementing use cases best suited for Kafka

* Write code to automate tasks ( request processing, product installations, health checks, proactive monitoring, alerting, reporting, predictive analytics )

* Write Kafka producer code and Kafka consumer code within consumer groups to test the Kafka client APIs, develop Kafka application best practices, and help safely onboard Kafka applications to our Kafka platforms (across programming languages/platforms)

* Configure and test pre-built Kafka Connectors for integrating Kakfa with other systems

* Design, code, and test new Kafka Connectors where needed for integrating Kakfa with other systems

* Perform optimization and tuning of Kafka

* Design monitoring solutions for the platform and baseline statistics reporting

* Work on creating best practices, standards, Integration patterns and on-boarding process automation

* Ability to work with application development teams to understand usage pattern and provide solutions

* Lead in collaborating with other infrastructure teams to achieve high resiliency and scalability of our Kafka Messaging platforms

* Provide technical expertise in scoping end to end business requirements and assist in reflecting them in implementation for different Kafka connectors

* Conduct technical reviews of integration implementation for all SDLC phases to assess the quality of integration solutions built on Kafka

* Strive to provide highly resilient Kafka Messaging systems using the latest high availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) technology solution

  
  

**What we value**

These skills will help you succeed in this role

* Love of writing code/programming

* Solid coding ability to write robust, fault tolerant, well tested code. Any scripting/programming language is fine but with willingness to learn Python, Ansible, Terraform, Puppet, Shell. Experience with source code control system

* Experience working on Red Hat Linux

* Deep level of understanding of Kafka Messaging or another Messaging technology

* Location – Bangalore or Hyderabad (Candidates not willing to relocate need not apply)

  

**Why this role is important to us**

The team you will be joining is a part of Platform Engineering Middleware, a function that is vital to the company as we execute over 2 million job runs per day in Autosys, support 3,500 web sites on over 3,000 servers (both internal and external facing), 5 Billion messages per day traverse Kafka and MQ across more than 150,000 queues, and we handle over 2 million file transfers per day. State Street is one of 6 banks designated by the federal reserve as GSIB (Global Systemically Important Bank) with nearly 4 trillion USD in AUM. Our Middleware platforms touch all areas of the company and are the vital plumbing serving all the banks activities. As a GSIB we operate under a strict oversight program from the Federal Reserve and must ensure our systems are operating at full capacity 24/7.
